title: Vault Manufacturing Data Authority and Release Governance

scope.purpose: Define Vault as the governed authority for manufacturing design truth and internal lifecycle while preserving the project CDE as the authority for published or transmitted project information.
scope.boundary: This standard governs authority, release, traceability, and publication handoff. It does not define detailed Vault administration or infrastructure configuration.

requirements.statement: Vault shall be the governed source for manufacturing design history and released manufacturing data within its assigned scope.
The project CDE shall remain the authoritative record for published or formally transmitted project information; Vault release does not itself constitute project publication or contractual exchange.

Manufacturing content used for governed BIM coordination or formal downstream exchange shall originate from an appropriate released Vault state unless a governed exception explicitly authorizes otherwise.
Published packages shall retain references to Vault identity, revision or lifecycle context, and release provenance sufficient to trace the project container back to the manufacturing source.
Changes after release shall create controlled new version or revision context, supersede prior releases where applicable, and trigger update of affected coordination or CDE records.

provenance.source_title: Vault as Manufacturing Data Authority & Release System
provenance.migration_note: Normalized the durable Vault-versus-CDE authority boundary and release-to-publication handoff. Product administration details were not promoted.
